asked.item: Does personal Facebook login use one of the 20 accounts?
Do not want to pay for it

verdict.reason: The pages state the personal Facebook login does not count toward the account limit, while each connected Page counts as one.

steps.text: No, the personal Facebook login does not count toward your plan's connected-account limit.
Each connected Facebook Page counts as one account.
You must keep the personal Facebook login connected, because Meta uses it to authorize Blotato's access to your Pages.
